applicability_conditions: Dislocation density is calculated by the variance method developed by Groma [31] applied to the (110) XRD peak profile; G is taken as 82 GPa; α is usually taken as 0.33. The strengthening contribution from dislocations is considered via the Taylor equation.
purpose: 采用 Taylor 方程计算位错对屈服强度的强化贡献（Δσ_ρ）。

symbols.meaning: 位错强化对屈服强度的贡献

unmapped: The dislocation density was calculated by the variance method developed by Groma [31] applied to the (110) XRD peak profile.
In Ref. [40] the dislocation density was determined by TEM.
The present study utilizes XRD to determine dislocation density, taking into account a large area for dislocation density analysis.
